proof_kind: same-author explicit arguments plus exact tests

theorems.name_zh: 观察安全强商保持全时间首达律
theorems.assumptions: Finite stochastic chain; HIT/UNKNOWN absorption colors; exact target-class row sums; fixed arrow duration
theorems.statement: K P=P Kbar implies equality of every first-passage time mass and all convergent generating values.
theorems.novelty: No priority claim over classical bisimulation, weighted automata, or Doob transforms

theorems.name_zh: 对称概率与原子通道需要不同欠账状态
theorems.assumptions: Symmetric stopped U/V family; 0<c<1; threshold R>=1
theorems.statement: 4R-2 raw safe states reduce to R+1 frozen-law safe states, or 2R atomwise safe states. Biased/action-chosen futures need renewed certificates.
theorems.novelty: No priority claim over classical bisimulation, weighted automata, or Doob transforms

theorems.name_zh: 有限Krylov闭合判断全时间首达等价
theorems.assumptions: Complete finite chain; frozen kernel Q and one-step hit column b
theorems.statement: Equality on span{Q^k b} is equivalent to all-time first-hit equality. Observable rank <= safe state count.
theorems.novelty: No priority claim over classical bisimulation, weighted automata, or Doob transforms

theorems.name_zh: 首达读数等价不保证正状态可合并
theorems.statement: Two states share all first-hit probabilities but cannot be merged by strong stochastic lumping. Signed recurrence coefficients are not BRC masses.
theorems.novelty: No priority claim over classical bisimulation, weighted automata, or Doob transforms

theorems.name_zh: 条件首达变换与观察安全商交换
theorems.assumptions: Complete finite chain; h=P(hit)>0 on retained conditional states; strong lumping
theorems.statement: Doob K^h_ij=K_ij*h_j/h_i commutes with quotient and preserves conditional time law.
theorems.novelty: No priority claim over classical bisimulation, weighted automata, or Doob transforms

theorems.name_zh: 停止对称六轴进位的风险—条件时间律
theorems.statement: Risk=1/T_R(1/c); E[tau|hit]=x T_R′(x)/T_R(x). At fixed c<1 it is asymptotically linear in R, while c=1 gives R^2.
theorems.novelty: No priority claim over classical bisimulation, weighted automata, or Doob transforms

theorems.name_zh: 未展开质量的概率包围在强商下不变
theorems.assumptions: HIT and UNKNOWN separately preserved; incomplete exact frontier
theorems.statement: Both endpoint probabilities and full first-terminal time laws are preserved; lower/upper reachability enclosure unchanged.
theorems.novelty: No priority claim over classical bisimulation, weighted automata, or Doob transforms
